rationale: The only candidate (9e96ee69c81d, 'ref: fix unnecessary casts hiding type errors') is a typing clean-up that routes the queue header lookup through a _required() helper without changing the queue-routing behaviour this change added, so no functional defect was repaired.

The only candidate (60b3d6816b0a) is an architectural refactor replacing the custom OpenUV data object with DataUpdateCoordinators, which made the added async_update method obsolete rather than fixing a bug in it.

The only candidate (92df1c10173a) changes read_csv's default file filtering and wraps the reader in try/except for a clearer error message; the blamed csv.open_csv(...) lines were only re-indented and the invalid_row_handler re-init was left untouched.
The only candidate (40596f05dd94) deletes the whole file while merging DDPSpawnStrategy into DDPStrategy, a refactor that gives no sign the changed _set_world_ranks signature was defective.

This change is a revert that restored the pre-existing defensive copy=True in block.slice; the candidate re-lands Arrow 7 support with a custom serializer (a workaround for an upstream Arrow pickling bug) and drops the copy as no longer needed, so the blamed line was a deliberate workaround, not a defect.

The only candidate (aae800d988bc, 'DEPR: internals') enforces a deprecation by deleting the whole module-level __getattr__ shim for CategoricalBlock; the find_stack_level() call restored by this revert was not buggy.

The candidate is a 'chore' refactor into a silo service abstraction (with an unverified import-reordering attempt at a ModuleDeadlock bundled in) that carries over the same None-guarded close and REGION-only Kafka logic, so the blamed lines were restructured, not repaired.

The change hard-coded 'lightning-app' for the editable-install egg-info lookup and 'lightning_app' for the git repo-name check, so _prepare_lightning_wheels_and_requirements stopped matching the default 'lightning' install and repo, and the 'hot fix' three days later restored 'lightning' as the default through a package_name parameter.

The change passed mode=brotli.BrotliEncoderMode.TEXT, a name the Python brotli module does not expose, and the same-day fix replaced it with brotli.MODE_TEXT; spotting it requires knowing the brotli library's API.

Candidate 2 changes this change's new counter-init line to read the powertrain-bus counter instead of the camera-bus counter for 'reliable relay open', which may fix a flaw in that line or just harden a partial mitigation of start-up LKAS faults that pre-dated the change; candidates 1 and 3 are a send-rate tweak and a clean-up that only refactor the blamed lines.
The only candidate (01b1c6512c15, 'ref(dynamic-sampling): Remove multiplexer') deletes the whole file as a refactor; nothing in it repairs get_enabled_user_biases.

The refactor replaced the fixed bs = 1 for LoadImages sources with bs = len(dataset), so the batch size became the dataset length for image/video inputs, and the 'TensorRT detect.py inference fix' two days later restored bs = 1 except for webcam streams; confirming it needs LoadImages.__len__ and how bs is used later in the file.
